TC-19/S12.productIssue: NEW (U14a / U8, no gate). A silent pre-round Save Note re-dates yesterday's one-time dose. The chart was processed at T0 with 'Magnesium sulfate 2 g IV once', shown as Given · Oct 13. At T0+30 h the physician saves the pre-round 'Overnight uneventful. No complaints this morning.' The row now reads Given · Oct 14 (today) and its updatedAt is restamped to now, so at 37 h it is still on the Medications panel, when it should have left with metoprolol (last mentioned at T0). Seen in 2 of 2 completed live runs (a third attempt, report-142730, timed out). Root cause: src/domain/medications.ts mergePreRoundMedications (e02167f, the echo guard at lines 491-503 and the restamp at 532-550) skips a row the extractor only echoes back from the names on file only when the echo says st === 'active'. A single-dose row that comes back is restamped: changeDate = today (isSingle → stampDate2) and updatedAt = now, which also breaks the function's own comment ('neither is a row it only echoes back'). Checked by calling the pure function (scratchpad merge-echo.ts): an echoed 'Magnesium sulfate' (single-dose) is re-dated to Oct 14; an echoed active metoprolol is untouched; an empty answer leaves the row alone (as the socket-mocked diag run on the app showed). Breaks UAT TC-19 ER 8 (a one-time dose shows as Given and expires), ER 10 / 3.6 (36 h window), and the TC-19 AI check (no change dictated → no row changed). Also seen (gated, TFA-94699 in progress, U14b): at 37 h the four rows are still on the server record until a device runs rounding:applyLifecycle; convex/crons.ts has only the session sweep.
